Saved result figure The same public fixed-input calculation. Shows solutions, analytic/independent references or errors; numerical criteria and CSV are linked in the execution entry. Equations and problem definitions Geometric-Brownian Itô SDE dX=μXdt+σXdW; no SDE-specific entry exists among the 46 equations. Scalar Ito diffusion: GBM and OU dXt=a(Xt,t) dt+b(Xt,t) dWt GBM: a=μX, b=σX;OU: a=κ(θ−X), b=σ Scalar SDEs with deterministic initial states. Separate weak moment bias,strong errors on shared Brownian paths and finite-sample MCSE. OU is a related bath-component check,not the full harmonic Langevin system. Formulations used by execution examples Common execution exampleProblem definition Itô SDE: strong convergence with coupled Brownian paths dX=μX dt+σX dW X(T)=X0exp⁡[(μ−σ2/2)T+σW(T)] Euler–Maruyama for scalar geometric Brownian motion. Coarse/fine steps and analytic endpoints share the same Brownian paths; measure strong RMS error across 4096 paths. Does not validate general SDEs, MCMC or weak convergence order.
